crossRefs.note: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”
Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last…
so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give…
We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.
They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

translations.web: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
translations.bsb: The slacker craves yet has nothing, but the soul of the diligent is fully satisfied.
translations.kjv: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
translations.asv: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing; But the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
